frog.speaker: H
frog.excerpt: Corfoo (sic) We have arrived at Corfoo. Nono has taken us aboard Allegra. I go and get into my bathing suit. I can swim but not very well. Nono has fixed a rope to the side of Allegra. I can nearly float. I’ve also learnt to do breaststroke, frog leg and to tread water. Nonno has a grey motor dinghy which we pretend is a six eyed shark. Denise sleeps in the front cabin. I sleep with Mummy and Daddy in the back cabin.

frog.speaker: F
frog.excerpt: It is our last day in Corfu. We are catching the one o’clock ferry to Igoumenitsa. The ferry is a converted tank landing craft. I found out that the vehicle can float with its door down and the anchor is bigger than Dad. From Igoumenitsa we went through some mountains. We saw mule trains carrying wood and some single mules. We drove through some clouds. There are lots of sheep and goats. We turned off the road for the night. There was a stream with lots of tadpoles and frogs, a very few about 2 inches long, they were camouflaged on top and yellow and blue underneath.

frog.speaker: H
frog.excerpt: We have been in another car ferry from Corfu to a place in Greece. We are driving up a mountain in the evening. We stopped at a valley with a stream and some frogs. I made a bivouac by a tree. We saw lots of mules, sheep and goats. The goats came quite closer and so did a few mules. The sheep were on the next mountain.

frog.speaker: G/M
frog.excerpt: Rained buckets during night, v. cold and windy. Little stream with tadpoles, frogs, yellow and splodged underneath.

frog.speaker: D
frog.excerpt: We camped last night just off the road, in the mountains. There were a few trees dotted around and a little stream. In the stream there were big and small tadpoles and frogs, the big frogs had spotty yellow tummies. There were also some small nests. We were slightly on a slant, and it was very cold. Lots of animals went past us, sheep and goats and a small mule train, nearly all the animals had bells round their necks, they made a pleasant, assorted, jingling sound. When we drove down out of the mist, it warmed up, we went to see some monasteries on top of some enormous rocks, we also climbed on to see a cave.

fred.speaker: D
fred.excerpt: Slept in caravan again. Dad went to work in London (in his old suit!) Stayed the morning at Betty’s, swam, slept and read. Lunch with Betty, pizza and C.M. pie, fruit salad after. Went for another short swim, then drove to Dover, fetched Dad, (all trains went wrong). Waited in queue, and then got on Ferry. Found place to sit and then, off Dad’s jacket! (It was old and worn out) got some very queer looks from other people! Used up all English money buying food and drink, revolting but fun. Arrived in France and drove, we were very tired, finally stopped and slept in Fred.

fred.speaker: F
fred.excerpt: Went to Salzburg. I saw a nice fountain there. Found 65 pfennings and bought some soldiers, then we went to a horrible camp site. On the way to it we went through a big tunnel and up a steep hill. Fred only just made it.

fred.speaker: F
fred.excerpt: We went to a nice campsite. We parked Fred in some trees. Helena, Denise and I had a swim, it was lovely. Then we went to the van and had dinner. After that Mum and Dad came, I kindled a fire by myself. There was a path on the water made by the moon.

puncture_tyre_breakdown.speaker: D
puncture_tyre_breakdown.excerpt: Car broke down twice, oh dear! We were late to have our last cholera injections.

puncture_tyre_breakdown.speaker: D
puncture_tyre_breakdown.excerpt: Rhiannon’s Birthday. I slept on the floor, my injection arm hurt and I felt very tired when I woke up. Watched television and played with rabbits, 8 new baby ones, 4 weeks old, very nice. Went swimming but no-one would come in with me. Had lunch, fish and chips, I had an egg. Had the fruit salad and ice cream as well. Played, Olympic Games, but Rhiannon fell over and everyone disagreed with each other … Went to Cobham with Mum to buy some cassettes, but car broke down, bought 3 empty cassettes, took car to garage, bought some sweets. Went back to Morgan’s, got F & H and are now driving to Luxfords. Dad is taking a train. Arrive at Lux, have dinner, bed.

stork.speaker: G/M
stork.excerpt: Mileage = 29455 (1855 miles travelled). Photo of stork on church. Meteora caves v. good. Finished film. Started new one with telephoto.

ferry.speaker: D
ferry.excerpt: Slept in caravan again. Dad went to work in London (in his old suit!) Stayed the morning at Betty’s, swam, slept and read. Lunch with Betty, pizza and C.M. pie, fruit salad after. (It was old and worn out) got some very queer looks from other people! Used up all English money buying food and drink, revolting but fun. Arrived in France and drove, we were very tired, finally stopped and slept in Fred.

ferry.speaker: F
ferry.excerpt: Going on ferry to Calais, ripped up Dad’s jacket [and flung it overboard to signify the end of working in England]. Then we had dinner at 11 o’clock.

ferry.speaker: D
ferry.excerpt: Still on big campsite, loos etc. revolting, just lazing around, had lunch and then left for Dubrovnik. Found the nice beach and went swimming again, lovely. When we came back up to the car, we got changed into warm clothes, for the ferry. We then went back to the little market and then on to the ferry port, we had to wait a long time to get on though. At last, we are on and the ferry has left the port, we’ve had dinner, and are playing a few games before we go to bed. Helena and I squashed into the same sleeping bag, but we swapped and changed before we really settled down.

ferry.speaker: F
ferry.excerpt: We went to a beach where we swam. It was a pebble beach. There were lots of waves. I had a cold shower. After a long wait we got on the ferry to Dubrovnik. We had dinner and tried to go to sleep. I was sharing with the girls. In the end, Mum said that we could get up and go with Dad. He had three German friends, they taught me and Denise poker. At ten I had to go to bed.

ferry.speaker: D
ferry.excerpt: The ferry at last arrived in Corfu and after a bit of fuss, we got off, then we drove round to Gouvia Bay, and found Alegra, Nono came out in the dinghy to fetch us and then we all swam. We carried [on] swimming, eating and lazing around at appropriate times until bed time, it was good to sleep in a nice bed again.

ferry.speaker: F
ferry.excerpt: In the morning, I woke up, got dressed and had breakfast of chocolate and bread. We got off the ferry. We almost had to go to Iguamenitsa. After we had got off the ferry we parked near a hotel. We had trouble finding Nono. At last we got on Alegra, it was lovely. We swam. There were three JB 007 books I started - The man with the Golden Gun. For dinner we had ham and salad then we went to bed.

ferry.speaker: D
ferry.excerpt: Today is our last day in Corfu. We are actually in Corfu town now, and have been in a nice park. Mum and Dad came and we all sat on a little wall doing our diaries and eating nougat. Then we drove onto the Ferry. When we arrived, we drove through the rain, up to some mountains, we drove up and down, and around the mountains, in and out of the clouds, they were very low and misty (the clouds). We saw lots of herds of sheep and goats, crossing the road, or grazing on the mountains, always with a shepherd or shepherdess and sometimes, a dog, we also saw some long lines of mules, horses and donkey, carrying firewood and other things.

ferry.speaker: F
ferry.excerpt: It is our last day in Corfu. We are catching the one o’clock ferry to Igoumenitsa. The ferry is a converted tank landing craft. I found out that the vehicle can float with its door down and the anchor is bigger than Dad. From Igoumenitsa we went through some mountains. We saw mule trains carrying wood and some single mules. We drove through some clouds. There are lots of sheep and goats. We turned off the road for the night. There was a stream with lots of tadpoles and frogs, a very few about 2 inches long, they were camouflaged on top and yellow and blue underneath.

ferry.speaker: H
ferry.excerpt: We have been in another car ferry from Corfu to a place in Greece. We are driving up a mountain in the evening. We stopped at a valley with a stream and some frogs. cave.speaker: D
cave.excerpt: Postojna. Got up and went to caves, they were beautiful, long queue, bought tickets and got on a little train, it was cold in the caves. We went along on the train and then had to get off and walk round with an English speaking guide, who told us about the various caves as we went through. There were lots of stalagmites, and tites, they were very beautiful. Got on train again and went out.

cave.speaker: F
cave.excerpt: In the Postojna Jama in Yugoslavia. We got onto an electric train. It took us to the caves. Then the train stopped and we got out. From there on we had a guided tour. Went to some large caves, there were lots of stalagmites and stalactites.

cave.speaker: H
cave.excerpt: I stayed in a campsite by the sea. And went to see some beautiful caves and there were lots of halls. I went on a train too. Spaghetti hall - stalactites looked like spaghetti. And we had an ice cream. I stroked some sea urchins by the sea and I swam in cold water.

cave.speaker: D
cave.excerpt: We are still in little bay, but hope to go to Paxos at around 4.30 this afternoon. Nono is working on the water pump, so the rest of us are setting off in the dinghy to look at some caves. We are going out to a small island, there are quite a few caves in its cliffs. The first few are really just niches, but then we came to a bigger one - carefully we took the boat in, it was quite frightening, we went on to see some others but they weren’t quite as good. We went to Paxos, the sea was quite calm but I felt a little ill, had a rather disastrous evening out, but Nono bought me a ring.

cave.speaker: G/M
cave.excerpt: Off Allegra. Drove to Paleokastrizza. Visit to cave, swim, lunch. Drove to Glyfada Beach - long, sandy with lily? white flowers. Lovely smelling, poking out of the brownish sand. On to Aguis Giordis. Stopped en route in olive grove. Invited for glass of wine by Tom & Helen Wrightson of York. Just building a house. V. pleasant.

cave.speaker: D
cave.excerpt: Today we left the boat, and went in the van, to the other side of Corfu, we followed almost exactly the route we took 3 years ago on motor scooters, then we came to a beach with a big cave which we swam to. We camped in a nice olive grove, and some people invited us to have drinks, we had a pleasant and interesting conversation.

cave.speaker: F
cave.excerpt: Went to Paleoskatritsa - a beach in Corfu. We swam to a small cave - it was super. I dived off a rock. There were lots of people. Me and Helena made a H0-00 scale castle. I filled it with Foreign Legion [mini-soldiers]. Then we went to Glyfada.

cave.speaker: H
cave.excerpt: Went to a beach, swam to a nice cave, had lunch and built a castle. Then we walked home.

cave.speaker: G/M
cave.excerpt: Mileage = 29455 (1855 miles travelled). Photo of stork on church. Meteora caves v. good. Finished film. Started new one with telephoto.

cave.speaker: F
cave.excerpt: It has been raining today. We had porridge. Helena and I tracked the stream. We found it ended in marsh then we found some more stream. It had no life in so we transported some life then we had to go. We drove to some monasteries! They were on some huge steep rocks like towers. We tried to go into one but you had to pay and there were huge queues. There were lots of blackberries, we picked some. Then we tried to go to some old caves probably used by hermits. The path was very narrow.

cave.speaker: H
cave.excerpt: We have driven to some monasteries. They were nice. Daddy and Denise wanted to go inside but they could not. The monasteries were on some steep rock mountains. We tried to climb to a cave but we could not.

cave.speaker: F
cave.excerpt: Sent postcard to Adam Hill. Dear Adam, I have been in a tank-landing craft. It has an anchor as big as a man. I also went to some caves, they were huge. One had a bridge made by Ruskie POWS in the First war. Love from Francis.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: H
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: I stayed in a campsite by the sea. And went to see some beautiful caves and there were lots of halls. I went on a train too. Spaghetti hall - stalactites looked like spaghetti. And we had an ice cream. I stroked some sea urchins by the sea and I swam in cold water.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: F
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: Found lots of sea urchins and stroked some. Helena found a dried spider starfish. This was in a campsite in Yugoslavia.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: D
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: Got up early and got the van ready. Mum and Dad went back to Senj to get petrol and bread. Went to swim, it was cold, so we couldn’t pluck up the courage to swim, we found a little rock pool, and then a starfish, we put the starfish in the pool, it was a pretty one, then Mum and Dad came back with some delicious bread. We all got in the van and started the drive to Dubrovnik, eating the warm bread and biscuits, we have come upon a crash, because the road is very wet, no one can get through, so we will probably be here for a few hours. At last, we finally moved on, but passed about 10 more accidents, it was so late that we didn’t go to Dubrovnik, we stopped at a lovely campsite, and went swimming in warm blue water.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: F
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: When Alegra started moving, my soldiers moved as though they were alive. There was a column and they went into small groups. We had lunch with Joanne on a terrace. In the bay we made an aquarium - it had 4 starfish, one with nine tentacles, 3 were black and one was orange and black and purple. There were lots of sea urchins, some black, some red, some purple, some brown, some a mixture of colours. Also there was a crab the same size as the ones I caught yesterday.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: H
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: I have made an aquarium. In it there are two small spider starfish and one big one and a nine legged one and some sea urchins. I also went to see a girl called Joanna and had chips and omelette and salad. We saw a wreck.

starfish_sea_urchin.speaker: F
starfish_sea_urchin.excerpt: The Bay. This Bay was in the Mediterranean Sea in Greece. The end of it is blocked by a spit. The land was sandy with trees. There are sea urchins dotted around the shore. The bottom was weed with patches of sand. The land was mainly gorse, olive and pine.

mule.speaker: G/M
mule.excerpt: Mileage = 29381 (1781 miles travelled). Camped on main ?? near Heisovan?. Lots of goats. Some of the land is open. Fertile plateau. Took some photos of mules, mule ?? and goats.

tortoise.speaker: D
tortoise.excerpt: Today we drove a lot, first on good roads, but then we turned off on to, as the map called it, a ‘non-asphalt’ road, the surface was very bad, and it wound round and round the mountains, We finally reached the small village of Olympus, shopped and swam. Then we drove about a mile out and stopped for lunch by the sea, we thought we were secluded, and pranced about naked, only to discover that we were just next to the ground of a big Hotel! We drove on, and in a wood mum spotted a tortoise on the road, we stopped and played with it.

tortoise.speaker: F
tortoise.excerpt: We went along a very long road. There was a tortoise, I tried to feed it. We had chocolate and bread. It was nice chocolate, it tasted peppermintish. For lunch we stopped at Olympus Beach. I found a wasps nest. I lifted up a stone, the end was covered with wasps. I swam twice on a lagoon, I saw a six inch dragonfly (?).

tortoise.speaker: H
tortoise.excerpt: We woke up by a stream that was in a ravine. I saw a birds nest. Francis and I went to pick some flowers. We crushed and mixed them and put them in the nest. Later on we found a tortoise. He was on a road that ran through an oakwood. It was eleven o’clock and we played with him but he would not eat his elevenses which was a dandelion leaf.
